reviews.comment: I LOVED Mr. Bassett! Attendance was not mandatory, but his lectures were so interesting and entertaining that going to class was worthwhile. There were 4-5 pop quizzes, but he generally gave hints as to when they would take place. He also provided very thorough exam study guides. He is very passionate about sociology and cares for his students!

he was super helpful and nice. he seems like he really enjoys what hes teaching and hes really funny. the class consists of 4/5 pop quizzes, but they are pretty easy if you read what you're supposed to. there is 4 exams which are also easy if you study. Overall, a great professor and a good class!

reviews.comment: I think it was his first year teaching. He had 5 pop quizzes and 4 test for the whole grade. Test were incredibly reasonable and his test reviews were very informative. His lectures were hilarious, as he has mastered the art of dry humor and loved getting off topic. He put alot of effort in and loved getting feedback from his students.
